performanceComparison.parentInterpretation: Prepared synthetic helper timings. Borrowed Rust medians are below Node in all five workloads; observed min/max ranges do not overlap for settings, review policy, and marker, while invitation and rule-context ranges overlap, so no clear repeatable advantage is claimed for those two. This is not a statistical-significance analysis. Projection to owned JSON, checksum, serialization, and destruction are excluded from borrowed timing; callers materializing owned JSON retain that cost. No end-to-end caller, production CPU/RSS/throughput, or production latency claim is made.
performanceComparison.scope: prepared synthetic helper workload; not production traffic or end-to-end latency
